faq.q: গুৱাহাটী এখন উচ্চ ভূমিকম্পৰ অঞ্চলত আছে নেকি?
faq.a: হয় । গুৱাহাটী আইএছ ছিছমিক জোন V ত আছে — ভাৰতৰ সৰ্বোচ্চ ভূমিকম্পৰ বিপদাশংকা শ্ৰেণী । সৰু কম্পনবোৰ সাধাৰণ হয় আৰু প্ৰতিটো ঘটনাই স্তম্ভ, বীম আৰু দেৱালত থকা ফাটলবোৰক চাপ দিব পাৰে ।

উত্তৰ-পূব ভাৰত অঞ্চলত সঘনাই গৌণ আৰু মধ্যমীয়া ভূমিকম্পৰ কাৰ্যকলাপ ৰেকৰ্ড কৰা হয় । ইউএছজিএছে সাধাৰণতে অসম, মেঘালয়, অৰুণাচল প্ৰদেশ আৰু চুবুৰীয়া অঞ্চলসমূহত প্ৰতি সপ্তাহত ২. ৫ মাত্ৰাৰ ওপৰৰ একাধিক ঘটনা তালিকাভুক্ত কৰে ।

faq.q: মোৰ ঘৰৰ ওচৰত সৰু কম্পনৰ বিষয়ে মই চিন্তিত হ 'ব লাগে নেকি?
faq.a: সৰু কম্পনে খুব কমেই ভালকৈ নিৰ্মিত গাঁথনিৰ নতুন ক্ষতিসাধন কৰে, কিন্তু তেওঁলোকে বিদ্যমান গাঁথনিগত ফাটলবোৰ প্ৰসাৰিত কৰিব পাৰে । যদি আপুনি বীম-কলাম জয়েন্টসমূহত ফাটল লক্ষ্য কৰে বা তৰল দেৱাল ফাটল লক্ষ্য কৰে, এটা ডাঙৰ ঘটনাৰ বাবে অপেক্ষা কৰাৰ সলনি এটা গঠনমূলক পৰিদৰ্শন বুক কৰক ।

ঘটনাৰ তথ্য US Geological Survey (USGS) ৰ ৰাজহুৱা খাদ্যৰ পৰা আহৰণ কৰা হয়, প্ৰায় পাঁচ মিনিটৰ বিলম্বৰ সৈতে । চৰকাৰী ভাৰতৰ সতৰ্কতাৰ বাবে, নেচনেল চেণ্টাৰ ফৰ সিসম 'লজি (এনচিএছ) আৰু আইএমডিৰ কথা উল্লেখ কৰক ।

sections.title: কাঠামোগত যান্ত্ৰিকতা (স্তম্ভ বনাম ইনফিল দেৱাল)
sections.body: Many property owners mistake brickwork partition cracks for benign settling. Brick walls carry zero structural load and exist purely for privacy and decoration. The entire weight profile of the building is carried by the columns, beams, and slabs. One single unchecked crack in a load-bearing column or beam intersection completely interrupts the structural load distribution path. Under sudden lateral earthquake loads, these compromised joints suffer sudden brittle failure, initiating total progressive collapse.

stages.label: ষ্টেজ 02 [ৰাসায়নিক লিচিং]
stages.text: আর্দ্রতা প্ৰব্ৰজন কৰি কেলচিয়াম হাইড্ৰক্সাইড দ্রবীভূত কৰে আৰু লিক কৰে, কাঠামোগত কংক্রিট ফ্ৰেমৰ ভিতৰত অদৃশ্য আভ্যন্তৰীণ শূন্য গাঁথনি সৃষ্টি কৰে ।

stages.label: মঞ্চ ০৩ [পুনৰ সম্প্ৰসাৰণ অনুঘটক]
stages.text: আদ্ৰতা আভ্যন্তৰীণ তীখা শক্তিশালীকৰণ ৰিবাৰৰ সৈতে যোগাযোগ কৰে, অক্সিডেচন আৰম্ভ কৰে । ৰাস্টিং ষ্টীল ইয়াৰ মূল ভৌতিক আয়তনৰ ৬০০ % লৈকে বিস্তৃত ।

stages.label: ষ্টেজ 04 [কাঠামোগত স্প্লিং]
stages.text: এই চৰম আভ্যন্তৰীণ চাপৰ ফলত কংক্রিটটো ভিতৰৰ পৰা ভাগি পৰে আৰু বন্ধ হৈ যায়, কাঠামোগত অখণ্ডতা শূন্যলৈ নামি যায় ।

sections.title: Global Compliance Indices (NDT আৰু Retrofitting Lifecycles)
sections.body: আন্তৰ্জাতিক বিল্ডিং ক 'ড ষ্টেণ্ডাৰ্ড (এচিআই ৩১৮) আৰু ভাৰতীয় কংক্রিট ক' ড (আইএছ ৪৫৬) এ স্পষ্টভাৱে নিৰ্দেশ দিয়ে যে সকলো বাণিজ্যিক, ৰাজহুৱা, আৰু উচ্চ-অধিকাৰী আৱাসিক গাঁথনি নিয়ন্ত্ৰিত অ-ধ্বংসাত্মক পৰীক্ষণ (এনডিটি) অডিট (অতিস্বনক পাল্ছ বেগ মেপিং আৰু ৰিবাউণ্ড হেমাৰ এৰে ব্যৱহাৰ কৰি) প্ৰতি ৩ৰ পৰা ৫ বছৰত গভীৰভাৱে লুকাই থকা দুৰ্বলতা উদ্ঘাটন কৰে ।

points.title: প্ৰি-টাইল ঝিল্লী একত্ৰীকৰণ
points.body: টাইলছ লগোৱাৰ আগতে কাঁচা বাথৰুমৰ কংক্রিটৰ মেট্ৰিকেৰে পোনপটীয়াকৈ উচ্চ-পারফরমেন্স ইলাস্টোমাৰিক পলিইউৰেথেন পানীৰোধী কাৰ্য্য সম্পাদন কৰা । সমাপ্ত টাইল এৰে ভংগ কৰি উপ-পৃষ্ঠীয় কৈশিক লিকৰ পৰিশোধৰ বাবে দিনটোৰ শূন্যত প্ৰতিৰোধমূলক বাধা প্ৰণয়ন কৰাতকৈ ৫০০ % অধিক খৰচ হয় ।

points.title: অধিগ্ৰহণ NDT পৰীক্ষণ
points.body: কচমেটিক পেইন্টৰ এখন দৃশ্যত সতেজ কোটৰ ওপৰত ভিত্তি কৰি কেতিয়াও এটা সম্পদ ক্ৰয় বা মালিকানা ল 'ব নালাগে । ৰিয়েল ইষ্টেট লেনদেন চূড়ান্ত কৰাৰ আগতে বিল্ডিং কঙ্কালৰ লুকাই থকা সংকোচকাৰী মূল শক্তিৰ মূল্যায়ন কৰিবলৈ আনুষ্ঠানিক এন ডি টি ডায়াগনছ্টিক মূল্যায়নৰ ওপৰত জোৰ দিয়ক ।

services.title: ৰিট্ৰফিটিং
services.description: এটা স্তম্ভত ফাট? এইটোৰ ওপৰত ৰং নকৰিবা । আমি দুৰ্বল স্তম্ভ আৰু বীমক শক্তিশালী কৰোঁ যাতে আপোনাৰ সমতলটো পৰৱৰ্তী কম্পনৰ পৰা ৰক্ষা পৰে — কাৰ্বন ফাইবাৰ মেৰামতি, কংক্রিট মেৰামতি, আৰু আধাৰশিলাৰ কাম ।

services.title: ৱাটাৰ প্ৰুফিং
services.description: গুৱাহাটীত সাধাৰণ মৌচুমী ছাতি ফুটোৱা, বাথৰুমৰ ছিপেজ, তলা স্খলন । আপোনাৰ ষ্টীলটো জংঘল কৰাৰ আগতে আমি পানী বন্ধ কৰি দিওঁ আৰু ভিতৰৰ পৰা আপোনাৰ দেৱালবোৰ দুৰ্বল কৰি দিওঁ ।

services.title: বিল্ডিং শক্তি পৰীক্ষা
services.description: বেলটোলা বা চান্দমাৰীত এটা পুনৰ বিক্ৰী কৰা ফ্লেট কিনা? প্ৰথমে আপোনাৰ ভৱনৰ বাবে এটা এক্স-ৰে লাভ কৰক । অ-ধ্বংসাত্মক পৰীক্ষাবোৰে আপুনি চহী কৰাৰ আগতে লুকুৱাই ৰখা দুৰ্বলতা প্ৰকাশ কৰে ।

services.title: তাপ প্ৰতিৰোধক
services.description: এপ্ৰিল-জুনত শীৰ্ষ-তলা সমতল অসহনীয়? বতৰ শীতল আবৰণে ছাদৰ পৃষ্ঠৰ তাপমাত্ৰা ১৪ °C লৈ কম কৰে — কম এচি, কম বিল ।

services.title: সম্প্ৰসাৰণ যুটীয়া চিকিৎসা
services.description: বিল্ডিং ব্লকসমূহৰ মাজৰ ব্যৱধানবোৰ মৌচুমী পানীত সোমাবলৈ দিয়া । আমি জয়েন্টবোৰ সঠিকভাৱে ছীল কৰোঁ যাতে পানী আৰু ফাটল আপোনাৰ এপাৰ্টমেণ্ট কমপ্লেক্সৰ জৰিয়তে বিয়পি নপৰে ।

services.title: বৰষুণৰ পানী সংগ্ৰহ
services.description: গুৱাহাটীত প্ৰচণ্ড বৰষুণ হয় — ইয়াৰ বেছিভাগেই অপচয় হয় । ফ্লাশ্বিং আৰু গাৰ্ডেনিংৰ বাবে ছাদৰ পানী ধৰা, অথবা শুকাই যোৱাৰ আগতে আপোনাৰ ব 'ৰৱেলটো চাৰ্জ কৰক ।

services.title: PU ইনজেকশন গ্ৰাউটিং
services.description: ফাটৰ জৰিয়তে সক্ৰিয় পানীৰ লিক বন্ধ কৰক — পলিইউৰেথেন ইঞ্জেকচন পানীৰ সৈতে বেচমেন্ট, টেৰাচ আৰু জয়েন্টবোৰ চীল কৰিবলৈ বিস্তাৰিত হয় ।

services.title: ইপোক্সি ইঞ্জেকশন
services.description: শুকান ফাটলত কাঠামোগত শক্তি পুনৰুদ্ধাৰ কৰক — লোড বহন কৰা মেৰামতিৰ বাবে স্তম্ভ আৰু বীমত ইপোক্সি বন্ধন কংক্রিট ।

services.title: কাৰ্বন ফাইবাৰ শক্তিশালীকৰণ
services.description: চিএফআৰপি মেৰামতিয়ে বৃহৎ স্তম্ভ অবিহনে ভূমিকম্পৰ শক্তি যোগ কৰে — গুৱাহাটী এপাৰ্টমেন্ট ৰিট্ৰফিটৰ বাবে আদৰ্শ ।

services.title: কাঠামোগত মেৰামতি
services.description: স্পেলিং মেৰামতি, পুনৰাবৃত্তি, মাইক্ৰ 'কনক্ৰেটিং, আৰু জেকেটিং - এইটো বিফল হোৱাৰ আগতে ক্ষতিগ্ৰস্ত কংক্রিট ঠিক কৰা ।

services.title: মাইক্ৰ 'কনক্ৰেটিং
services.description: গাঁথনিটো খুলি নোখোৱাকৈ স্তম্ভ আৰু শ্ল্যাবৰ ভিতৰত মৌচাক আৰু শূন্যস্থান পূৰ কৰা ।

services.title: ভূমিকম্পৰ জেকটিং
services.description: আইএছ ক 'ডৰ প্ৰতি স্তম্ভ আৰু বীম জেকেটিং — জোন ভি ভৱনৰ বাবে আবদ্ধ ইস্পাত আৰু উচ্চ-শক্তিৰ গ্ৰাউট ।

services.title: কংক্রিট কৰ্কট চিকিৎসা
services.description: স্প্লিং কৰাৰ আগতে ক্ষয়িত ইস্পাত, ডিলেমিনেটেড কংক্রিট, আৰু ক্ল 'ৰাইডৰ ক্ষতিৰ চিকিৎসা কৰা ।

servicePages.title: ৰিট্ৰফিটিং
servicePages.headline: আপোনাৰ গুৱাহাটীক ঘৰুৱা ভূমিকম্পৰ বাবে সাজু কৰক
servicePages.intro: যদি আপুনি গুৱাহাটীত বাস কৰে, আপোনাৰ ঘৰ ভূমিকম্পৰ অঞ্চল V ত আছে — ভাৰতৰ সৰ্বাধিক ভূমিকম্পৰ বিপদাশংকা । ৰিট্ৰফিটিংৰ অৰ্থ হ 'ল আপোনাৰ ইতিমধ্যে যি আছে তাক শক্তিশালী কৰা: স্তম্ভ, বীম, ফাউণ্ডেশ্যন আৰু স্ল্যাব — গতিকে পৰৱৰ্তী কম্পনে এটা সৰু ফাটলক এটা ধসে পৰা তলালৈ ৰূপান্তৰ নকৰে ।

awareness.headline: আপোনাৰ স্তম্ভত থকা সেই ফাটটো সাধাৰণ বসতি স্থাপন নহয় ।
awareness.body: বেছিভাগ গুৱাহাটী গৃহমালিকাই ফাটক উপেক্ষা কৰে কাৰণ নিৰ্মাতাই কৈছিল যে 'এইটো নিষ্পত্তি হৈছে' বা কাৰণ এটা নতুন ৰঙৰ কোটত সমস্যাটো লুকাই আছে । কোঠাৰ মাজৰ বিভাজন দেৱালত এটা ফাট সাধাৰণতে ক্ষতিকাৰক নহয় । এটা স্তম্ভ, মরীচি, বা য 'ত দেৱাল ছাতিৰ সৈতে মিলিত হয় তাৰ মাজেৰে চলি থকা এটা ফাটল নহয় । ভূমিকম্পত, সেই দুৰ্বল বিন্দু হঠাতে বিফল হ' ব পাৰে — আৰু ইয়াৰ ওপৰত থকা সকলোবোৰ তললৈ নামি আহিব পাৰে । আপুনি জানিবলৈ পৰৱৰ্তী কম্পন অনুভৱ কৰা পৰ্যন্ত অপেক্ষা নকৰিব ।

offerings.name: কাৰ্বন ফাইবাৰ (CFRP) মেৰামতি
offerings.description: পাতল, উচ্চ-শক্তি কাৰ্বন ফাইবাৰ চিটবোৰ দুৰ্বল স্তম্ভ আৰু বীমৰ চাৰিওফালে আৱৰি আছে — আপোনাৰ বিল্ডিংৰ কঙ্কালৰ বাবে এটা নিক্ষেপৰ দৰে । ই স্তম্ভবোৰ বৰ্দ্ধিত নকৰাকৈ শক্তি যোগ কৰে ।
offerings.whenUsed: যেতিয়া স্তম্ভ বা বীমৰ ফাটল থাকে বা শক্তি হেৰাই যায় কিন্তু গাঁথনি এতিয়াও সংৰক্ষণযোগ্য — গুৱাহাটীত ১৫-৩০ বছৰ পুৰণি আৰচিচি ফ্লেটত সাধাৰণ ।
offerings.whyItMatters: এটা দুৰ্বল স্তম্ভ এটা মধ্যমীয়া ভূমিকম্পত ফুটি উঠিব পাৰে । ওপৰৰ তলাবোৰ পেনকেক কৰিব পাৰে । ভাঙি পৰাৰ পিছত মেৰামতিৰ খৰচ এতিয়া শক্তিশালী কৰাতকৈ ১০× অধিক — যদি ভৱনটো আনকি উদ্ধাৰযোগ্য হয় ।

offerings.name: মাইক্ৰ 'কনক্ৰেটিং
offerings.description: বিশেষ উচ্চ-শক্তিৰ গ্ৰাউটটো কংক্রিটৰ ভিতৰৰ ঠালা বা মৌচুমী অঞ্চলত ইনজেকচন কৰা হয় — দুৰ্বল নিৰ্মাণ বা বয়সৰ দ্বাৰা অৱশিষ্ট শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰা ।
offerings.whenUsed: যেতিয়া শক্তি পৰীক্ষণ নিৰ্মাণ কৰা হয় তেতিয়া স্তম্ভ বা শ্ল্যাবৰ ভিতৰত খালী পকেট দেখুৱায়, অথবা যেতিয়া আপুনি দেৱালত টোপ দিয়াৰ সময়ত খালী শব্দ শুনে ।
offerings.whyItMatters: ঠালা কংক্রিটৰ অৰ্থ হ 'ল তীখা শক্তিশালীকৰণ অসুৰক্ষিত । আৰ্দ্ৰতা ভিতৰৰ পৰা ইস্পাত, মৃৎশিল্প প্ৰসাৰিত, আৰু কংক্রিটৰ বিস্ফোৰণত উপনীত হয় — প্ৰায়ে পৃষ্ঠত কোনো সতৰ্কবাণী চিহ্ন নাথাকে ।

offerings.name: মর্টাৰ মেৰামতি কৰক
offerings.description: কাঠামোগত মেৰামতিৰ ম 'ৰ্টাৰ ছিলে কংক্রিটত ফাট দিয়ে আৰু পৃষ্ঠত পুনৰুদ্ধাৰ কৰে — মৌচুমীৰ পানী ভিতৰৰ ষ্টীলত প্ৰৱেশ কৰাত বাধা দিয়ে ।
offerings.whenUsed: যেতিয়া আপুনি কাঠামোগত সদস্যত দৃশ্যমান ফাটল, স্প্লিং (কংক্রিট ফ্লেকিং অফ), বা স্তম্ভ আৰু বীমত স্যাঁতসেঁতে প্যাচ দেখা পায় ।
offerings.whyItMatters: মৃৎশিল্পই ইয়াৰ আকাৰৰ ৬ গুণ পৰ্যন্ত ইস্পাত বিস্তাৰ কৰে । কংক্রিটটো ভিতৰৰ পৰা ভাগি যায় । আজি হেয়াৰলাইন ফাটলৰ দৰে দেখিবলৈ এখন আৰ্দ্ৰ মৌচুমীৰ পিছত এটা ভাঙি যোৱা স্তম্ভ হ 'ব পাৰে ।

offerings.name: গ্ৰাউটিং
offerings.description: চিমেণ্ট বা ইপোক্সি গ্ৰাউটে চাদৰ, স্তম্ভ আৰু ইঁটৰ কামৰ মাজত আৰু অসম ভিত্তিবোৰৰ মাজত শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰে — পুনৰ সমানভাৱে ল 'ড বিয়পি পৰে ।
offerings.whenUsed: যেতিয়া মেৰাবোৰে অসমান অনুভৱ কৰে, দৰ্জা ভালদৰে বন্ধ নহয়, বা বসতি স্থাপন বা কম্পনৰ পিছত কাঠামোগত সদস্যসকলৰ মাজত ব্যৱধান দেখা দিয়ে ।
offerings.whyItMatters: অসমান লোড বিতৰণে কম স্তম্ভত অতিৰিক্ত চাপ পেলায় । এটা স্তম্ভে তিনিটা ওজন লয় — আৰু ভূমিকম্পত প্ৰথমে বিফল হয় ।

offerings.name: ৰিবেৰিং (স্টিল প্ৰতিস্থাপন)
offerings.description: কংক্রিটৰ ভিতৰত ক 'ৰ' ডেড ষ্টীল বাৰবোৰ উন্মোচন কৰা হয়, পৰিষ্কাৰ কৰা হয়, আৰু নতুন শক্তিশালীকৰণৰ সৈতে প্ৰতিস্থাপন বা পৰিপূৰক কৰা হয় — তাৰপাছত পুনৰ ছীল কৰা হয় ।
offerings.whenUsed: যেতিয়া কংক্রিটটো ৰস্টেড ষ্টীলৰ উন্মোচন বন্ধ হৈ যায়, অথবা যেতিয়া পৰীক্ষণবোৰে দেখুৱায় যে শক্তিশালীকৰণ ক্ষমতা হেৰুৱাইছে ।
offerings.whyItMatters: চুপি চুপি ইয়াৰ শক্তিৰ ৫০ % হেৰুৱাব পাৰে । ভৱনটো ভূমিকম্পৰ চাপৰ তলত অকস্মাৎ বিফল নোহোৱা পৰ্য্যন্ত ভাল দেখা গৈছে ।

offerings.name: ভিত্তি শক্তিশালী কৰা
offerings.description: গুৱাহাটীৰ কোমল মাটিত স্থাপন কৰা, ঢাকি ৰখা বা বহা ভিত্তিসমূহক সুস্থিৰ কৰাৰ বাবে মাটিৰ চিকিৎসা আৰু মাটিৰ চিকিৎসা ।
offerings.whenUsed: তলৰ অঞ্চলবোৰত পুৰণি ঘৰবোৰ (ভৰালুমুখ, পাণ্ডু, নুনমতিৰ কিছু অংশ) দৃশ্যমান ঢাল, তলৰ ঢাল, বা তলৰ স্তৰৰ ফাটলৰ সৈতে ।
offerings.whyItMatters: প্ৰতিষ্ঠানৰ বিফলতাই গোটেই ভৱনত প্ৰভাৱ পেলায় । এটা শক্তিশালী ভূমিকম্পৰ সময়ত লিকুইফায়েবল মাটিত, এটা অপ্ৰতিৰোধ্য ভিত্তি স্থানান্তৰ কৰিব পাৰে — পাইপ ছিঙি পেলাব পাৰে আৰু গাঁথনিটো ভাগ কৰিব পাৰে ।

sections.body: দুটা কোঠাৰ মাজৰ প্লাষ্টাৰত এটা সূক্ষ্ম ফাটল সাধাৰণতে কচমেটিক হয় — ইট বিভাজনৰ কোনো ল 'ড নাই । এটা ফাটল যি এটা স্তম্ভৰ শাৰী অনুসৰণ কৰে, এটা দেৱালৰ ছাতিৰ যোজ্যতাত ত্ৰিভূজীয়ভাৱে চলে, বা প্ৰত্যেক কম্পনৰ পিছত প্ৰসাৰিত হয় । যদি আপুনি এটা মুদ্ৰাক ফাটকাত খাপ খুৱাব পাৰে আৰু এইটো গভীৰলৈ যায়, অথবা যদি ফাটকটো পুনৰুজ্জীৱিত কৰাৰ পিছত পুনৰ দেখা দিয়ে, তেন্তে আমাক ফোন কৰক ।

sections.body: বিল্ডিং ক 'ড বিদ্যমান — কিন্তু প্ৰয়োগ আৰু নিৰ্মাণৰ মান ভিন্ন হয় । যোৱা ১০ বছৰত নিৰ্মিত বহুতো ফ্লেটত একেই লুকাই থকা সমস্যা আছে: মধুময় কংক্রিট, অপৰ্যাপ্ত ইস্পাত, আৰু দ্ৰুত আৰোগ্য । এটা সম্পত্তি তালিকাত এটা' নতুন 'টেগ মানে ভূমিকম্প-নিৰ্ভৰশীল নহয় । এটা বিল্ডিং শক্তি পৰীক্ষা কেইঘন্টা সময় লয় আৰু তোমাক সঁচা কথা কয় ।

sections.title: What happens in the next tremor — treated vs untreated
sections.body: An untreated home with a cracked column: the tremor shakes the building, stress concentrates at the crack, the column shears, upper floors lose support. A retrofitted home: the same tremor is absorbed by strengthened columns — cracks may not grow, floors stay supported.

sections.title: How RCC strength drops over time
sections.body: Concrete does not stay at day-one strength forever. Carbonation front moves inward and reduces alkalinity that protects steel. Cover spalls, chlorides from poor mix or leaks reach rebar, and corrosion expands. IS 456 expects durability planning — not build-and-forget. A 25-year column in Guwahati monsoon can test 30–40% below original design assumptions if never maintained.

servicePages.headline: Stop monsoon damage before it reaches your steel
servicePages.intro: Guwahati's monsoon is brutal on buildings. A small roof leak today becomes a rusted column tomorrow. Waterproofing isn't cosmetic — it's how you stop water from eating your home from inside.

awareness.headline: That damp patch on your ceiling isn't 'just humidity'
awareness.body: Water follows gravity and capillary action. A leak on the terrace travels down through concrete, reaches steel reinforcement, and starts rust. By the time you see a yellow stain on your bedroom ceiling, the damage inside the slab may already be serious. Painting over it makes it invisible — not fixed.

offerings.name: Rooftop waterproofing (double coat)
offerings.description: Two layers of waterproof coating over your terrace — the first line of defence against Guwahati's monsoon.
offerings.whenUsed: When you see pooling water on the terrace, leaks after rain, or your top-floor ceiling has damp patches.
offerings.whyItMatters: Standing water on a flat roof adds weight and finds every crack. One season of unchecked leakage can halve your slab's remaining life.

offerings.name: Screed slope correction
offerings.description: We rebuild the terrace slope so water flows to drains instead of sitting in puddles.
offerings.whenUsed: When water pools in corners after rain — common in older Guwahati buildings with flat or reversed slopes.
offerings.whyItMatters: Pooled water finds the weakest point. Every monsoon the same spot gets worse until water breaks through.

offerings.name: Bathroom waterproofing (before tiles)
offerings.description: Waterproof membrane applied on raw bathroom floor and walls before tiling — the correct way to build.
offerings.whenUsed: During new construction or renovation, before tiles go on. Also when redoing a bathroom that leaks to the floor below.
offerings.whyItMatters: Fixing a leaking tiled bathroom means breaking all tiles and starting over — 5× the cost of doing it right the first time.

offerings.name: Basement & plinth waterproofing
offerings.description: PU injection and coating for ground floors and basements — especially where municipal road height has risen above your plinth.
offerings.whenUsed: When ground-floor walls are damp year-round, white salt deposits appear, or water enters during heavy rain.
offerings.whyItMatters: Guwahati's water table is shallow. Hydrostatic pressure pushes water through walls like a hydraulic press. Paint and damp-proof courses fail within months.

offerings.name: Polyurethane (PU) coating
offerings.description: Flexible, durable coating that handles foot traffic on terraces and movement in walls.
offerings.whenUsed: Terraces, balconies, and areas that expand and contract with heat.
offerings.whyItMatters: Rigid coatings crack in Guwahati's heat-cold cycle. Flexible PU stays sealed.

offerings.name: Acrylic & elastomeric coating
offerings.description: UV-resistant coatings that reflect heat and block water — good for exterior walls and sun-facing surfaces.
offerings.whenUsed: Sun-facing walls with fine cracks, terraces with light foot traffic, and exterior surfaces.
offerings.whyItMatters: Cracks in exterior walls let monsoon water in. One wet season can rust every steel tie in the wall.

sections.title: The Guwahati monsoon trap
sections.body: From May to September, Guwahati gets heavy rain almost daily. Flat terraces, shared apartment roofs, and old drainage systems can't cope. If your upstairs neighbour's terrace isn't waterproofed, your ceiling pays the price. If your own terrace has cracks, your columns absorb the water.

sections.title: Signs you need waterproofing now
bullets: Yellow-brown stains on ceiling or walls after rain
Peeling paint or bubbling plaster in bathroom or terrace-adjacent rooms
Musty smell that returns every monsoon
White powder (efflorescence) on ground-floor walls
Water dripping from terrace drain areas

sections.title: Diagnosis before coating
sections.body: We flood-test terraces, map moisture on ceilings, and check parapet and drain details before specifying membrane type. Coating over active cracks or ponding water fails within one season — diagnosis first saves repeat cost.

sections.title: Systems we specify
bullets: PU liquid membrane for trafficked terraces
Bituminous multilayer with protection course
Crystalline systems for basements
Bathroom membranes before tiling
Parapet upturn and penetration detailing

servicePages.headline: Know if your building is actually strong
servicePages.intro: A fresh paint job hides a lot. A building strength test (called NDT — Non-Destructive Testing) tells you what's really inside your columns and slabs — without breaking anything open.

awareness.headline: Don't buy a Guwahati flat based on looks alone
awareness.body: Every week, families in Guwahati buy resale flats in Beltola, Six Mile, and Zoo Road based on location and paint. They don't know the column in the master bedroom has hollow concrete. They find out after the first monsoon leak — or worse, after a tremor widens a hidden crack. A half-day test costs a fraction of your down payment and can save everything.

offerings.name: Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity (UPV) test
offerings.description: Sound waves are sent through concrete — like an ultrasound. Weak, hollow, or cracked areas show up clearly on the reading.
offerings.whenUsed: When you need to know internal concrete quality — especially in columns, slabs, and load-bearing walls.
offerings.whyItMatters: Hollow concrete can look perfect from outside. UPV finds the voids before they become collapse points.

offerings.name: Rebound Hammer test
offerings.description: A spring-loaded device measures surface hardness of concrete — indicating compressive strength.
offerings.whenUsed: Quick screening of multiple columns and slabs — common in pre-purchase inspections.
offerings.whyItMatters: Soft concrete means the building was poorly mixed or has aged badly. It won't carry earthquake load as designed.

offerings.name: Crack mapping & risk report
offerings.description: We measure, photograph, and classify every crack — structural vs cosmetic — with a plain-language report.
offerings.whenUsed: After tremors, when buying a property, or when multiple cracks appear across the flat.
offerings.whyItMatters: Not all cracks are equal. Without mapping, you either panic unnecessarily or ignore something fatal.

offerings.name: Pre-purchase building report
offerings.description: Full strength assessment before you pay a deposit — with clear pass/fail guidance on each structural element.
offerings.whenUsed: Before signing any resale flat or independent house purchase in Guwahati.
offerings.whyItMatters: Banks check paperwork, not concrete quality. You're the one living there when something fails.

sections.title: Who should get tested?
bullets: Anyone buying a resale flat or house in Guwahati
Owners of buildings 10+ years old — especially pre-2010 construction
Flats where cracks appeared after recent tremors
Housing societies planning major renovation or additional floors
Landlords who want to protect tenants and avoid liability

sections.title: What you'll receive
sections.body: A clear report in plain language — not a 50-page engineering document. We mark which columns passed, which need attention, and what it will cost to fix. You decide whether to proceed with purchase, negotiate price, or walk away.

sections.title: How RCC strength decreases with age
sections.body: Carbonation, chloride ingress, and cover loss reduce effective strength over decades — often with no visible warning until spalling or a tremor widens cracks. Rebound hammer and UPV show what paint hides. A building that 'looks fine' at 20 years may have columns below design capacity.

sections.title: When to retest — every 3 to 5 years
sections.body: IS 456 and good international practice treat structural health as ongoing. After major tremors, visible new cracks, or completed retrofit work, retest sooner. For older occupied buildings, a 3–5 year NDT cycle catches corrosion and strength loss before emergency repair.

sections.title: Other states already mandate audits
sections.body: Maharashtra requires structural audits for certain ageing and dilapidated buildings. Delhi authorities have pushed periodic safety inspections on old structures. Kerala intensified assessments after flood damage. Assam has not yet mandated the same — but owners who wait for law often pay emergency prices after failure.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Buying or living in an older flat? Know the truth before it's too late.

servicePages.headline: Survive Guwahati summer without ₹10,000 AC bills
servicePages.intro: If you live on the top floor in Guwahati, you already know — April to June is unbearable. Heatproofing reflects sun off your roof so your flat stays cooler and your AC works less.

awareness.headline: Your roof is a frying pan — and you're living under it
awareness.body: Unprotected concrete roofs in Guwahati reach 50–55°C in summer. That heat radiates into your ceiling all night. You're paying to cool a flat that reheats every afternoon. Heatproofing isn't luxury — it's the cheapest way to cut your electricity bill.

offerings.name: Weather Cool thermal coating
offerings.description: Advanced reflective coating that bounces sunlight off your terrace — reducing surface temperature by up to 14°C.
offerings.whenUsed: Top-floor flats, exposed terraces, metal roofs, and sun-facing walls.
offerings.whyItMatters: Every degree cooler on the roof = lower AC runtime. Most families recover the cost in one summer season.

offerings.name: Multi-layer heat insulation
offerings.description: Combined primer, reflective coat, and protective top layer for maximum heat rejection and durability.
offerings.whenUsed: Large terraces, commercial spaces, and buildings where single-coat hasn't been enough.
offerings.whyItMatters: Single cheap coatings fail in one monsoon. Multi-layer systems last 5–7 years.

sections.title: Best for Guwahati homeowners
bullets: Top-floor 2BHK and 3BHK flats in apartment complexes
Independent houses with direct sun on RCC roof
Home offices that overheat by noon
Rental properties — tenants pay AC bills and complain

sections.title: Bonus: your roof lasts longer
sections.body: Heat causes concrete to expand and contract daily — creating micro-cracks that let monsoon water in. Heatproofing reduces thermal stress, so your waterproofing lasts longer too.

servicePages.ctaMessage: Tired of sweating through summer? One coating before April changes everything.

servicePages.title: সম্প্ৰসাৰণ যুটীয়া চিকিৎসা
servicePages.headline: Stop water entering through building gaps
servicePages.intro: Those gaps between building blocks in your apartment complex aren't mistakes — they're expansion joints. But when sealant fails, monsoon water pours through — into parking, stairwells, and lower floors.

awareness.headline: The gap in your parking lot ceiling is letting water reach your car — and your columns
awareness.body: Expansion joints are designed to let buildings move safely with heat and settling. But in Guwahati's climate, sealants harden and crack within 3–5 years. Once water enters through a joint, it travels along steel reinforcement — rusting columns from inside while you see nothing on the surface.

offerings.name: Joint sealant replacement
offerings.description: Old cracked sealant is removed and replaced with flexible, waterproof material that moves with the building.
offerings.whenUsed: When you see gaps, missing sealant, or water dripping through joints in parking, terrace edges, or stairwells.
offerings.whyItMatters: Water through joints reaches structural steel. Parking slab failure starts at untreated joints.

offerings.name: Waterproof joint coating
offerings.description: Additional waterproof layer over treated joints for high-exposure areas like terrace edges and podium levels.
offerings.whenUsed: Joints exposed to direct rain and UV — terrace perimeters, balcony edges, external wall junctions.
offerings.whyItMatters: Sealant alone isn't enough on exposed joints. Coating adds a second barrier.

sections.title: Common in Guwahati apartment complexes
sections.body: Multi-block societies in Beltola, Christian Basti, and GS Road areas often have expansion joints between towers, in basement parking, and at terrace junctions. Housing society managers often ignore them until a major leak forces emergency repair — at 3× the preventive cost.

sections.title: For housing societies
bullets: Schedule joint inspection every 3 years
Treat joints before monsoon, not after leaks appear
Document treatment for maintenance records and resale value

servicePages.ctaMessage: Managing a housing society? Joint treatment now prevents emergency repairs later.

awareness.headline: Your borewell is going dry — and the rain on your roof is wasted
awareness.body: Groundwater across Guwahati is dropping every year. Many homes in Panjabari, Kahilipara, and Narengi run borewells dry by March. Meanwhile, monsoon rain floods the terrace and goes straight to the drain. Harvesting connects the two problems into one solution.

offerings.whyItMatters: A 100 sq m roof in Guwahati can collect 1.7 lakh litres annually. That's free water you're currently throwing away.

offerings.whyItMatters: Recharge pits can raise water table by metres over 2–3 monsoons — extending borewell life by decades.

homeProblemGrid.headline: আপুনি কোনটো ভৱন সমস্যাৰ সন্মুখীন হৈছে?
homeProblemGrid.subhead: বেছিভাগ গৃহমালিকাই লক্ষণৰ সন্ধান কৰে, সমাধান নহয় । ইয়াত আৰম্ভ কৰক — আপুনি এইটো ঠিক কৰিবলৈ টকা খৰচ কৰাৰ আগতে আমি আপোনাক কি ভুল বুজিবলৈ সহায় কৰিম ।

doctorPositioning.subhead: ঠিকাদাৰসকলে সমাধান বিক্ৰী কৰে । আমি প্ৰথমে মূল কাৰণটো বিচাৰি পাওঁ — আপোনাৰ ভৱনটোৰ বাবে এজন চিকিৎসকৰ দৰে ।

points.title: প্ৰথম পৰিদৰ্শন
points.body: প্ৰতিটো প্ৰকল্প এটা চাইট ভিজিট আৰু চিনাক্তকৰণৰ সৈতে আৰম্ভ হয় — হোৱাটচএপৰ ওপৰত তাৎক্ষণিক উদ্ধৃতি নহয় ।

points.body: আমি PU ইঞ্জেকচন, ৱাটাৰপ্ৰুফিং, বা ৰিট্ৰফিটিংৰ পৰামৰ্শ দিয়াৰ আগতে NDT, আৰ্দ্ৰতা মেপিং, আৰু ক্ৰ্যাক মেপিং ।

points.title: বাৰ্ধক্যজনিত আৰচিচিৰ নিৰীক্ষণৰ প্ৰয়োজন
points.body: কেইবা দশক ধৰি কংক্রিট শক্তি আৰু ষ্টীল সুৰক্ষা অৱনমিত হৈছে — বিশেষকৈ গুৱাহাটী মৌচুমীত । জৰুৰীকালীন মেৰামতিৰ আগতে পর্যায়ক্রমিক এন ডি টিয়ে লুকাই থকা লোকচান ধৰা পেলায় ।

points.title: দীৰ্ঘম্যাদী স্থিৰীকৰণ
points.body: আমি কাৰণটো ঠিক কৰিছোঁ, লক্ষণটো নহয় । পৰৱৰ্তী মৌচুমী কালত বিফল হোৱা কোনো পেইন্ট-ওভাৰ-লিক প্যাচ নাই ।

problems.title: বেচমেন্টৰ পানীৰ ফুটো
problems.headline: কিয় আপোনাৰ তলাটো প্ৰতিটো মৌচুমীত বানপানী হয়?
problems.intro: গুৱাহাটীত বেচমেণ্ট ফুটো হোৱাটো খুব কমেই এটা জলসিঞ্চনৰ সমস্যা । উচ্চ পানীৰ টেবুল, দুৰ্বল বহিৰাগত ৱাটাৰপ্ৰুফিং, আৰু ফাটলযুক্ত ৰাফ্ট স্ল্যাববোৰ তলৰ পৰা আৰু দেৱালৰ মাজেৰে পানী ঢালিবলৈ দিয়ে ।
symptoms: বৰষুণৰ পিছত তলৰ মহলাত পানীৰ পুলি
ডাঠ দেৱাল আৰু বগা নিমখৰ জমা (ফুলা)
সংৰক্ষিত সামগ্ৰীবোৰত পাচলিৰ গোন্ধ আৰু ঢাল
মৌচুমীৰ সময়ত পাম্প অবিৰতভাৱে চলি থাকে
causes: ৰাফ্ট ফাউণ্ডেশ্যন বা ৰক্ষণাবেক্ষণৰ দেৱালত ফাট
উলুবাৰী, ভাংগাগড়ৰ দৰে নিচু অঞ্চলত ভূগৰ্ভস্থ পানীৰ বৃদ্ধি
ভৱনৰ চাৰিওফালে উপযুক্ত নিষ্কাশন বা চাম্প নাই
mistakes: উৎস ঠিক নকৰি স্যাঁতসেঁতে দেৱালৰ ওপৰত চিত্ৰাঙ্কন কৰা
কেৱল আভ্যন্তৰীণ চিমেণ্টিয়াছ লেপ (পানীৰ মাজেৰে ঠেলি)
কাঠামোগত ইস্পাত জংঘল নোহোৱা পৰ্যন্ত সৰু ছিপেজ উপেক্ষা কৰা হৈছে ।
problems.diagnosis: আমি আৰ্দ্ৰতাৰ প্ৰৱেশ বিন্দুবোৰ মেপ কৰোঁ, এনডিটিৰ সৈতে স্ল্যাব ফাটক পৰীক্ষা কৰোঁ, আৰু বহিৰ্তম শ্ৰেণীকৰণৰ মূল্যায়ন কৰোঁ । হাইড্ৰ 'ষ্টেটিক প্ৰেচাৰ টেষ্টে নিশ্চিত কৰে যে পানী তলৰ পৰা বা দেৱালৰ মাজেৰে প্ৰৱেশ কৰি আছে ।

faqs.q: তলা ফুটায়ে ক্ষতি স্তম্ভবোৰ ভাঙিব পাৰিবনে?
faqs.a: হয় । স্থায়ী আৰ্দ্ৰতা স্তম্ভ ভিত্তি শক্তিশালীকৰণক শক্তিশালী কৰে — সমগ্ৰ গাঁথনিটো নীৰৱে দুৰ্বল কৰি তোলে ।

faqs.q: বেচমেণ্ট ৱাটাৰপ্ৰুফিং কিমান দিনলৈ থাকে?
faqs.a: সঠিক বাহ্যিক + ক্ৰ্যাক মেৰামতিৰ সৈতে আভ্যন্তৰীণ প্ৰণালী সাধাৰণতে ৰক্ষণাবেক্ষণৰ সৈতে ১০-১৫ বছৰ থাকে ।

problems.title: মাটি আৰু ছাদৰ ফুটো
problems.headline: মাটি লিক হয় যিয়ে তলৰ চিলিংবোৰ ধ্বংস কৰে
problems.intro: গুৱাহাটীৰ ফ্লেটৰ ছাদবোৰে নৃশংস মৌচুমী শাস্তি লয় । স্থায়ী পানী, বিফল পানী প্ৰতিৰোধক স্তৰ, আৰু খোলা সম্প্ৰসাৰণ জয়েন্টবোৰে তলৰ দুটা তলা শুকোৱাৰ আগতে পানীক আনুভূমিকভাৱে ভ্ৰমণ কৰিবলৈ দিয়ে ।
symptoms: উপৰ মহলাত পিলিং পেইন্ট আৰু বুদবুদ প্লাষ্টাৰ
প্ৰচণ্ড বৰষুণৰ সময়ত পানীৰ বৰষুণ হয় ।
causes: বয়স্ক বিটুমেন বা এক্ৰাইলিক ৱাটাৰপ্ৰুফিং লেয়াৰ
ভাঙা টাইল গ্ৰাউট বা খোলা পাইপ প্ৰৱেশ ছীল
mistakes: প্ৰতি বছৰে অস্থায়ী টাৰ্প বা ছীলেন্ট পেচ
বিফল ঝিল্লী আঁতৰাব নোৱাৰি অন্য স্তৰ যোগ কৰা
problems.diagnosis: বানপানী পৰীক্ষা, ইনফ্রাৰেড আৰ্দ্ৰতা স্কেন, আৰু পেৰাপেট, নলা, আৰু অনুপ্রৱেশৰ চাক্ষুষ নিৰীক্ষণ । আমি টেৰাচ ৱাটাৰপ্ৰুফিং প্ৰণালীৰ পৰামৰ্শ দিয়াৰ আগতে পানীৰ পথৰ সন্ধান কৰো ।

faqs.q: মই প্ৰথমে পুনৰাবৃত্তি কৰা উচিত নে পুনৰাবৃত্তি কৰা উচিত?
faqs.a: সদায় প্ৰথমে ৱাটাৰপ্ৰুফ । এটা বিফল ঝিল্লী আৱৰ্জনাৰ ওপৰত নতুন টাইলছ — পৰৱৰ্তী মৌচুমী ঋতুত লিক ঘূৰি আহে ।

problems.title: স্নানাগাৰ ছিপেজ
problems.headline: তলৰ চুবুৰীয়াক প্ৰভাৱিত কৰা শৌচাগাৰ লিক
problems.intro: এপাৰ্টমেন্ট কমপ্লেক্সত স্নানাগাৰ ছিপেজ গুৱাহাটী আৰডব্লিউএ বৈঠকত এটা শীৰ্ষ অভিযোগ । পানীয়ে আটাইতকৈ দুৰ্বল যৌগটো বিচাৰি পায় — প্ৰায়ে ডব্লিউচি পেনৰ চাৰিওফালে, গা ধোৱা তলৰ ফাঁদ, বা নলৰ হাতা ।
symptoms: টাইল হোলাউনছেচ যেতিয়া ট্যাপ কৰা হয়
causes: টাইল বিছনাৰ তলত পানীৰ পৰীক্ষা বিফল হৈছে
স্লেব প্ৰৱেশত পাইপ হাতা সীলমোহৰ কৰা হোৱা নাই
গোসাঁইৰ সময়ত কোনো পুডল ফ্লেঞ্জ নাই
mistakes: তলা উত্তোলন নকৰাকৈ টাইলসমূহ পুনৰ ঘূৰাই দিয়া
স্থায়ী সমাধান হিচাপে WC আধাৰৰ চাৰিওফালে চিলিকন
আইনী জাননী নোহোৱা পৰ্যন্ত চুবুৰীয়া অভিযোগ উপেক্ষা কৰা
problems.diagnosis: প্লাম্বিং লাইনৰ ওপৰত চাপৰ পৰীক্ষা, তলৰ ফাঁদত ৰংৰ পৰীক্ষা, আৰু ঝিল্লী নিৰন্তৰ নিৰীক্ষণৰ বাবে নিৰ্বাচিত টাইল আঁতৰোৱা ।

faqs.q: মই বাথৰুমৰ সকলো টাইল ভাঙিব লাগিব নেকি?
faqs.a: সদায় নহয় । লিক উৎসত লক্ষ্যযুক্ত অপসাৰণ আৰু জয়েন্টবোৰত পি ইউ ইঞ্জেকচন প্ৰায়েই যথেষ্ট ।

problems.title: স্তম্ভৰ ফাটল
problems.headline: স্তম্ভত ফাটল — কেতিয়া চিন্তিত হ 'ব লাগে
problems.intro: এটা বিভাজন প্ৰাচীৰত এটা ফাট কচমেটিক হয় । ভূমিকম্পৰ অঞ্চল ভি গুৱাহাটীত এটা স্তম্ভৰ মাজেৰে চলি থকা এটা ফাটল হৈছে এটা কাঠামোগত ৰঙা পতাকা যিটোৱে তাৎক্ষণিক মূল্যায়নৰ দাবী কৰে ।
symptoms: স্তম্ভৰ মুখৰ মাজেৰে উলম্ব বা তির্যক ফাটল
causes: অপর্যাপ্ত শক্তিশালীকৰণ বা দুৰ্বল কংক্রিট ঢালক
mistakes: উপেক্ষা কৰা হৈছে কাৰণ ভৱনটো মাত্ৰ ১০ বছৰ পুৰণি ।
চেক নকৰাকৈ ল 'ড (পানীৰ টেংক, সম্প্ৰসাৰণ) যোগ কৰা হৈছে
problems.diagnosis: ক্ৰ্যাক মেপিং, কভাৰ মিটাৰ জৰীপ, ৰিবাউণ্ড হেমাৰ, আৰু অতিস্বনক নাড়ী গতি । আমি চিএফআৰপি মোড়ানো বা ইনজেকশন নিৰ্ধাৰণ কৰাৰ আগতে সক্ৰিয় বনাম সুপ্ত ফাটক শ্ৰেণীভুক্ত কৰোঁ ।

faqs.q: মই স্তম্ভৰ ফাটৰ সৈতে ভৱনটোত বাস কৰিব পাৰিমনে?
faqs.a: তীব্ৰতাৰ ওপৰত নিৰ্ভৰ কৰে । সক্ৰিয় প্ৰসাৰিত ফাটকাবোৰ জৰুৰী মূল্যায়নৰ প্ৰয়োজন — পৰৱৰ্তী কম্পন ঋতুৰ আগতে কিতাপ পৰিদৰ্শন ।

problems.title: দেৱালৰ ফাটল
problems.headline: কাঠামোগত বনাম অ-কাঠামোগত দেৱাল ফাটল
problems.intro: প্ৰতিটো দেৱালৰ ফাটলে আপোনাৰ ভৱনটো ধমকি নিদিয়ে । আমি গুৱাহাটীৰ গৃহমালিকাসকলক পাৰ্থক্য ক 'বলৈ সহায় কৰোঁ — আৰু মৌচুমীৰ পানী ষ্টীলত প্ৰৱেশ কৰাৰ আগতে কাঠামোগত ফাটক ঠিক কৰোঁ ।
causes: সংস্কাৰৰ পিছত পথ পৰিবৰ্তন লোড কৰক
mistakes: সকলো ফাটক একে ধৰণে চিকিৎসা কৰা
problems.diagnosis: ক্ৰ্যাক প্ৰস্থ নিৰীক্ষণ, প্লাম্ব পৰীক্ষণ, আৰু লোড পথ পৰ্যালোচনা । কাঠামোগত ফাটলসমূহে ইপোক্সি ইঞ্জেকশন বা ছেচিং পায়; প্ৰসাধনীসমূহ নমনীয় ফিলাৰসমূহ পায় ।

faqs.q: কোনটো ফাটল প্ৰস্থ বিপদজনক?
faqs.a: ল 'ড-বহন কৰা দেৱালত ৩ মি .মি. তকৈ অধিক ফাট, বা এটা স্তম্ভ/বীমৰ মাজেৰে যিকোনো ফাটল, পেছাদাৰী মূল্যায়নৰ প্ৰয়োজন ।

problems.title: ডাঠ দেৱাল আৰু পিলিং পেইন্ট
problems.headline: কিয় আপোনাৰ দেৱালসমূহ মৌচুমীৰ পিছত স্যাঁতসেঁতে থাকে
problems.intro: উদীয়মান স্যাঁতসেঁতে, পাৰ্শ্বীয় ছিপেজ, আৰু আভ্যন্তৰীণ ঘনীভৱন সকলোবোৰ "স্যাঁতসেঁতে দেৱাল" ৰ দৰে লাগিছে — কিন্তু প্ৰত্যেকেই এটা বেলেগ ফিক্সৰ প্ৰয়োজন । গুৱাহাটীৰ আৰ্দ্ৰতা এইটোক মাটিত আৰু ওপৰৰ মহলাত বেয়া কৰি তোলে ।
symptoms: দেৱাল স্পৰ্শ কৰিবলৈ ঠাণ্ডা আৰু ভেজাল অনুভৱ কৰে
causes: পুৰণি ভৱনত কোনো ডি পি চি (স্যাঁতসেঁতে প্ৰমাণ কৰা পাঠ্যক্ৰম) নাই
কাষৰ বাথৰুম/চৌহদৰ পৰা বহিৰাগত দেৱাল ছিপেজ
mistakes: উৎস নিৰ্ধাৰণ নকৰাকৈ এন্টি ডাম্প পেইন্ট
আভ্যন্তৰীণ প্লাষ্টিকৰ ঝিল্লীয়ে আৰ্দ্ৰতা লাভ কৰে
দেৱালৰ আৰ্দ্ৰতাক সম্বোধন নকৰাকৈ এচি চলাই থকা
problems.diagnosis: বহুতো উচ্চতাত আর্দ্রতা মিটাৰ প্ৰোফাইলিং, বহিৰাগত চাক্ষুষ জৰীপ, আৰু লৱণ বিশ্লেষণৰ জৰিয়তে উদীয়মান বনাম প্ৰৱেশকাৰী স্যাঁতসেঁতেৰ মাজত পাৰ্থক্য আছে ।

faqs.q: স্যাঁতসেঁতে প্ৰমাণ পেইন্টে কাম কৰে নেকি?
faqs.a: কেৱল পৃষ্ঠ ঘনীভৱনত । ৰাইজিং বা পাৰ্শ্বীয় ছিপেজৰ উৎসত পানী প্ৰতিৰোধৰ প্ৰয়োজন ।

problems.title: কংক্রিট স্পেলিং
problems.headline: Concrete falling off — exposed rusted steel
problems.intro: Spalling means steel inside concrete has rusted and expanded, bursting the cover. Common on Guwahati balconies, parapets, and coastal-exposed facades after years of monsoon.
symptoms: Exposed rebars on balcony slab edge
causes: Chloride ingress from poor concrete mix
Water sitting on flat balcony edges
mistakes: Patching with cement without treating steel
Ignoring balcony edge spalling as cosmetic
problems.diagnosis: Half-cell potential for corrosion activity, cover depth survey, and delamination mapping. Steel is cleaned, treated, and reinstated with repair mortar.

faqs.q: Is spalling urgent?
faqs.a: Yes. Exposed steel corrodes rapidly — load capacity drops and concrete can fall on people below.

problems.title: Foundation Settlement
problems.headline: Uneven floors and sticking doors — settlement signs
problems.intro: Guwahati soil varies from stiff clay to soft alluvium. Buildings on filled land or near Bharalu basin streams often show settlement years after construction.
causes: Consolidation of soft soil under load
problems.diagnosis: Level survey, crack pattern analysis, and borehole data where needed. Underpinning or grouting prescribed based on settlement mechanism.

faqs.q: Can settlement be stopped?
faqs.a: Often yes — with pressure grouting or underpinning once cause is confirmed.

problems.title: Failed Roof Waterproofing
problems.headline: When your waterproofing layer has given up
problems.intro: Most Guwahati terraces have 2–3 failed waterproofing attempts layered on top of each other. Heat, UV, and ponding water degrade membranes within 5–8 years if not maintained.
symptoms: Multiple repair patches visible on terrace
Green moss growth on terrace surface
Leak returns within one monsoon of repair
causes: Thermal cycling in black exposed membrane
mistakes: Using interior paint on exterior terrace
Not fixing slope before new membrane
problems.diagnosis: Core samples where possible, adhesion tests, and drainage assessment. Full system redesign vs localized repair decided on inspection.

faqs.q: Which waterproofing lasts longest on terraces?
faqs.a: PU liquid membrane or multilayer bituminous with protection tile — depends on traffic and budget.

problems.title: Expansion Joint Leakage
problems.headline: Water pouring through building expansion joints
problems.intro: Multi-block apartment complexes in Guwahati rely on expansion joints to move safely — but failed joint seals become highways for monsoon water into parking and flats.
symptoms: Stains along joint line on ceiling
mistakes: Rigid material in a moving joint
problems.diagnosis: Joint width measurement across seasons, movement assessment, and water test. Proper joint system selected for actual movement range.

faqs.q: Can expansion joints be made 100% watertight?
faqs.a: With correct profile, backing rod, and flexible sealant — yes, for designed movement range.

problems.title: Basement Dampness
problems.headline: Damp basement without visible flooding
problems.intro: Even without standing water, basements in Guwahati commercial buildings suffer high humidity from capillary rise and poor vapour barriers — damaging inventory and HVAC.
causes: High water table wicking through slab
problems.diagnosis: Hygrometer logging, slab moisture test, and drainage survey. Internal tanking vs external cutoff depends on access and water table.

faqs.q: Is basement dampness a health issue?
faqs.a: Yes — mould affects air quality. Commercial basements need humidity control plus source fix.

problems.title: Parapet Wall Leakage
problems.headline: Leaks at parapet — the most missed terrace detail
problems.intro: Water enters where parapet wall meets terrace slab — a detail often skipped by local waterproofers. In Guwahati high-rises, this causes chronic top-floor ceiling damage.
symptoms: Stains along top floor exterior wall
causes: No kick-out flashing at parapet base
mistakes: Low parapet height in wind zone
problems.diagnosis: Visual and flood test focused on parapet upturn, coping, and counter-flashing details.

faqs.q: Do I need to rebuild parapet?
faqs.a: Rarely. Proper upturn membrane and coping repair usually fixes it.

problems.title: Beam-Column Junction Cracks
problems.headline: Cracks where beam meets column — seismic risk
problems.intro: The beam-column joint is where earthquake forces concentrate. Hairline cracks here in older Guwahati RCC frames may indicate inadequate confinement steel.
problems.diagnosis: Structural audit per IS codes, NDT on joint zone, and seismic vulnerability screening.

faqs.q: Are joint cracks always serious?
faqs.a: In Zone V, yes — treat as structural until proven otherwise.

problems.title: Overhead Tank Leakage
problems.headline: Overhead tank leaks wasting water and weakening slabs
problems.intro: Overhead tanks on Guwahati rooftops often leak at panel joints and pipe connections — saturating slab below and adding dead load from stored water.
symptoms: Wet patch on terrace under tank
mistakes: External tank wrap without fixing joint
Extra tank load without slab check
problems.diagnosis: Tank empty inspection, slab capacity review, and support corrosion check.

faqs.q: Can slab hold a new larger tank?
faqs.a: Needs structural check — many older slabs were not designed for extra tank capacity.

problems.title: External Wall Seepage
problems.headline: Rain water soaking through external walls
problems.intro: Guwahati driving monsoon rain hits exposed west and south facades. Cracks in external plaster, failed paint, and open chajja joints let water into bedroom walls.
symptoms: Interior damp on external walls only
causes: No water repellent on porous brick
mistakes: Cheap exterior emulsion on bare brick
problems.diagnosis: Facade survey, window percolation test, and coating adhesion check.

faqs.q: Silicone coating vs proper plaster repair?
faqs.a: Coating is temporary on cracked substrate. Crack repair + breathable coating lasts longer.

problems.title: Slab Leakage
problems.headline: Water travelling through concrete slabs
problems.intro: Hidden slab leaks from embedded pipes or honeycombed concrete cause ceiling damage far from the source — common in Guwahati bathrooms and kitchens.
symptoms: Water meter running when taps off
Warm spot on floor (hot pipe leak)
problems.diagnosis: Thermal imaging, acoustic leak detection, and selective core test.

faqs.q: Can PU injection fix slab leaks?
faqs.a: Yes for porous concrete and some joint leaks — not for burst pipes (plumbing fix needed first).

problems.title: Steel Corrosion in Concrete
problems.headline: Rust inside concrete — silent strength loss
problems.intro: Carbonation and chloride attack reach steel in Guwahati coastal-influenced climate. Corrosion can consume 40% of bar strength before visible spalling.
problems.diagnosis: Half-cell, cover meter, and chloride sampling. Remaining life estimated before repair scope.

faqs.q: Can corrosion be reversed?
faqs.a: Steel can be treated and re-passivated; lost section needs supplemental reinforcement.

problems.title: Parking Basement Leakage
problems.headline: Water in stilt parking every monsoon
problems.intro: Stilt parking in Guwahati apartment projects often leaks at podium slab joints and ramp entrances — damaging vehicles and electrical panels.
symptoms: Efflorescence on columns at parking level
problems.diagnosis: Podium flood test, joint inspection, and drainage flow assessment.

faqs.q: Can parking be used during repair?
faqs.a: Phased repair possible — we section off bays to minimize disruption.

problems.title: Mould & Fungus Growth
problems.headline: Mould on walls — sign of deeper moisture problem
problems.intro: Mould in Guwahati flats is not just cleaning issue. It signals persistent moisture from leak, rising damp, or poor ventilation — affecting respiratory health.
problems.diagnosis: Moisture source tracing, air quality check, and ventilation assessment.

faqs.q: Will mould come back after cleaning?
faqs.a: Always, until moisture source is fixed.

problems.title: Weak Structure in Old Buildings
problems.headline: Is your 30-year-old Guwahati building still safe?
problems.intro: Many Guwahati buildings pre-2000 were built before modern seismic codes. Age, corrosion, and illegal modifications compound structural weakness.
problems.diagnosis: Full structural health assessment — NDT suite, load take-down, and seismic screening report.

faqs.q: How often should old buildings be assessed?
faqs.a: Every 5 years for 25+ year buildings in Zone V — more if cracks appear.

knowledgeArticles.title: What causes terrace leaks in Guwahati?
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Monsoon, flat roofs, and failed membranes — why terrace leaks are so common in Northeast India.
knowledgeArticles.body: Guwahati receives over 1,600mm rainfall annually, mostly concentrated in monsoon months. Flat terrace design — standard in apartment construction — allows water to pond if slope is inadequate. Over time, UV and heat cycling degrade waterproofing membranes. Penetrations around pipes and parapet upturns fail first. The fix starts with diagnosis: flood test and tracing water path before any new coating.

knowledgeArticles.title: Column crack vs settlement crack — how to tell
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Not all cracks are equal. Learn which patterns need urgent structural attention.
knowledgeArticles.body: Settlement cracks often appear as stair-steps in masonry or diagonal cracks at window corners. Column cracks run through the concrete member itself — often vertical or at beam-column joints. Width matters: cracks over 3mm in structural members warrant professional assessment. In Seismic Zone V, any column crack should be inspected before the next tremor season.

knowledgeArticles.title: PU injection vs epoxy injection — when to use which
knowledgeArticles.seoTitle: PU vs epoxy injection — when to use which
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Both fill cracks — but they work differently. Choosing wrong wastes money.
knowledgeArticles.body: PU (polyurethane) injection reacts with water to expand — ideal for active leaking cracks in basements and terraces. Epoxy injection bonds concrete structurally — used for dry structural cracks in columns and beams where strength restoration is needed. Many projects need both: PU to stop water, epoxy to restore capacity.

knowledgeArticles.title: Carbon fibre wrapping explained for homeowners
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: CFRP adds strength without bulky columns — how it works on Guwahati flats.
knowledgeArticles.body: Carbon fibre reinforced polymer (CFRP) sheets are epoxy-bonded to concrete surfaces. They add tensile capacity to weakened columns and beams with minimal thickness — important in occupied flats where space matters. It is not a paint product; surface prep and structural design are critical.

knowledgeArticles.title: Why get NDT before buying a resale flat in Guwahati
knowledgeArticles.seoTitle: NDT before buying a resale flat
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Hidden defects cost lakhs after purchase. A building strength test is cheap insurance.
knowledgeArticles.body: Rebound hammer, UPV, and cover meter tests reveal honeycomb, low strength concrete, and corroding steel — invisible during a normal flat viewing. In Beltola and Chandmari resale markets, 15–30 year buildings often have monsoon damage. NDT report gives negotiation leverage or avoids a bad purchase.

knowledgeArticles.title: Rising damp vs lateral seepage
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Both cause damp walls — but fixing the wrong one fails next monsoon.
knowledgeArticles.body: Rising damp shows up to 1m from floor — salt deposits, tide marks. Lateral seepage from adjacent bathroom or external wall affects mid-height patches. Ground floor flats in old Guwahati buildings often have both. Moisture meter profiling at multiple heights distinguishes them.

knowledgeArticles.title: Expansion joints in apartment buildings — why they leak
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Movement joints are necessary — but failed seals flood parking levels.
knowledgeArticles.body: Multi-block complexes need joints to absorb thermal and seismic movement. Sealant loses elasticity after 5–7 years. Rigid fillers crack. Proper repair uses correct joint width, backing rod, and movement-capable sealant — not cheap silicone.

knowledgeArticles.title: Seismic Zone V — what Guwahati homeowners should know
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Highest earthquake zone in India. What it means for your building.
knowledgeArticles.body: Guwahati sits in IS seismic Zone V. Older buildings may not meet current ductile detailing standards. Retrofitting — column jacketing, CFRP, joint confinement — reduces collapse risk. It is not optional luxury; it is risk management for your family.

knowledgeArticles.title: Basement waterproofing methods compared
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Internal tanking, external membrane, injection — which suits Guwahati soil?
knowledgeArticles.body: High water table areas need external cutoff where accessible. Internal crystalline systems work when excavation is impossible. PU injection handles active leaks through cracks. Often a combination is required — diagnosis determines sequence.

knowledgeArticles.title: Concrete spalling — catch it before chunks fall
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Rust stains and hollow sounds are warnings. Act before balcony edges fail.
knowledgeArticles.body: Spalling starts when steel corrodes inside concrete. Early signs: rust staining, fine cracks parallel to rebar, hollow sound when tapped. Patch repair without steel treatment fails in one monsoon. Proper repair: expose, clean, treat, reinstate with structural mortar.

knowledgeArticles.title: Heat reflective roof coating — does it work in Assam?
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Weather Cool and similar coatings — real temperature drop or marketing?
knowledgeArticles.body: Reflective coatings reduce surface temperature by up to 14°C on exposed terraces. They also extend underlying waterproofing life by reducing thermal stress. Best applied on stable substrate after leak repair — not over active leaks.

knowledgeArticles.title: Structural audit vs home inspection
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Property inspectors miss structural issues. Know the difference.
knowledgeArticles.body: Home inspection checks plumbing, electrical, and cosmetics. Structural audit uses NDT, crack mapping, and load review. For resale flats and old commercial buildings in Guwahati, structural audit is the relevant standard.

knowledgeArticles.title: Monsoon building maintenance checklist
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Pre-monsoon steps every Guwahati building owner should take.
knowledgeArticles.body: Clear terrace drains. Inspect parapet and pipe penetrations. Check expansion joints. Look for new cracks in columns. Test overhead tank overflows. Book professional inspection if building is 15+ years or shows any structural crack.

knowledgeArticles.title: RWA guide: terrace waterproofing decisions
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: How housing societies should evaluate contractor quotes fairly.
knowledgeArticles.body: Compare methodology not just price. Ask: membrane type, slope correction, penetration detail, warranty, and flood test protocol. Cheapest quote often skips parapet upturn and joint treatment — leak returns in one season.

knowledgeArticles.title: Illegal terrace rooms — structural risk
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Extra load on terrace slab can exceed design capacity.
knowledgeArticles.body: Many Guwahati buildings have unauthorized terrace rooms. Slab may not be designed for additional dead load. Combined with waterproofing failure, risk is significant. Structural check before any terrace use modification.

knowledgeArticles.title: Epoxy flooring for industrial warehouses
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: When concrete dust and forklift traffic need industrial grade floors.
knowledgeArticles.body: Epoxy and polyurethane floor systems handle abrasion, chemical spill, and heavy point loads. Surface prep — grinding and moisture test — determines adhesion. Paltan Bazar and outskirts warehouses benefit from phased bay application.

knowledgeArticles.title: Borewell recharge and rainwater harvesting in Guwahati
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Heavy rain, falling groundwater — capture and recharge responsibly.
knowledgeArticles.body: Rooftop rainwater can flush toilets and recharge borewells via soak pits — if soil and contamination risks are assessed. Reduces water bill and helps maintain groundwater in urban Guwahati.

knowledgeArticles.title: Building leak FAQ — quick answers for Guwahati
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Common questions about leaks, cracks, and repair costs.
knowledgeArticles.body: Q: Who fixes basement leaks in Guwahati? A: Building rehabilitation specialists with waterproofing and injection capability — not general painters. Q: Cost? A: Depends on diagnosis — inspection first. Q: How long? A: Terrace systems 7–14 days; column retrofit varies.

knowledgeArticles.title: Micro concreting for honeycomb repair
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Hollow columns sound bad — micro concreting fills voids without demolition.
knowledgeArticles.body: Honeycomb in columns leaves steel unprotected. High-strength grout injection fills voids. Used with NDT confirmation. Common in buildings with rushed pours during original construction boom.

knowledgeArticles.title: When to call a building doctor vs a contractor
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Symptoms vs root cause — who should you call first?
knowledgeArticles.body: Call a contractor when you know the fix: new tiles, paint job. Call a building rehabilitation specialist when you have symptoms — leak, crack, damp — but unknown cause. Diagnosis-first approach saves money long term.

knowledgeArticles.title: How to choose a waterproofing contractor in Guwahati
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Red flags, fair quotes, and what a proper terrace job includes.
knowledgeArticles.body: Compare methodology, not just per-sq-ft price. A proper Guwahati terrace job includes drain clearance, slope check, parapet upturn, penetration seals, and flood test — not a single acrylic coat. Ask for warranty in writing, previous society references in Beltola or Chandmari, and whether they diagnose before quoting. Avoid contractors who guarantee a fixed rate without site visit.

knowledgeArticles.title: Building crack repair cost in Guwahati — what to expect
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Cosmetic plaster vs structural column repair — very different budgets.
knowledgeArticles.body: Hairline wall crack filling may cost a few thousand rupees. Structural work — crack mapping, NDT, epoxy injection, CFRP wrap on columns — can run from ₹50,000 for a single member to several lakhs for a building wing. Guwahati Zone V buildings should not treat column cracks as cosmetic. Always get inspection before comparing quotes.

knowledgeArticles.title: Seismic retrofitting cost in Guwahati — 2026 guide
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: CFRP, jacketing, and NDT — what drives price for Guwahati homes.
knowledgeArticles.body: Retrofitting cost depends on member count, access, and strength deficit found in NDT. CFRP column wrap on a typical residential column may start around ₹15,000–40,000 per member; full building screening plus multiple jackets scales higher. Cheaper than emergency repair after damage — and far cheaper than life risk in Zone V.

knowledgeArticles.title: Monsoon roof leak in Guwahati — causes and fix
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Why flat terraces leak every monsoon in Guwahati and what actually fixes them — not another paint coat.
knowledgeArticles.body:
Guwahati gets over 1,600 mm of rain, mostly between May and September. Most apartment terraces are flat RCC slabs — water ponds if slope is wrong, then finds the weakest joint: pipe penetrations, parapet upturns, or old bitumen layers cracked by heat.

Common causes we see in Beltola, Chandmari, and Six Mile: failed waterproofing membrane under tiles, blocked terrace drains, expansion joint gaps between blocks, and parapet base details done wrong the first time.

Temporary fixes — silicone, tarp, local contractor re-coat — fail within one monsoon because water travels horizontally under the surface before dripping two floors below.

Proper fix starts with diagnosis: flood test, tracing the water path, checking drains and parapet. Then either localized PU injection for active cracks or full terrace waterproofing system with protection layer.

Cost depends on terrace area, existing failed layers, and whether tiles must be lifted. We quote after a free site inspection — not over WhatsApp.

If your ceiling stains every monsoon, book an inspection before the next heavy spell. Catching it early saves structural steel from rust inside the slab.

knowledgeArticles.title: Flat crack repair cost in Guwahati — what affects price
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Hairline plaster crack vs structural column crack — very different costs. Here's what drives price in Guwahati flats.
knowledgeArticles.body:
Not every crack costs the same. A stair-step crack in partition plaster might be ₹5,000–15,000 to repair properly. A crack through a column or beam in Seismic Zone V can run into lakhs if CFRP wrapping, injection, and NDT are needed.

Price drivers: crack width and length, whether steel is exposed or corroding, number of cracks, floor access (scaffolding for high-rise), and whether the crack is active (still widening) or dormant.

NDT — rebound hammer, UPV, cover meter — adds ₹15,000–40,000 depending on building size but prevents guessing. Many Guwahati resale buyers in Beltola and Zoo Road use this before purchase.

Epoxy injection for dry structural cracks: typically ₹800–2,500 per running metre depending on depth and access. PU injection for leaking cracks: similar range but may need multiple passes.

We don't give accurate quotes without seeing the crack in person. Photos help for triage, not pricing. Free inspection first — we'll tell you honestly if it's cosmetic, monitor-only, or urgent.

Waiting until monsoon water reaches steel inside the column often doubles repair cost. Book inspection early if the crack is in a column, beam, or load-bearing wall.

knowledgeArticles.title: Terrace waterproofing cost in Guwahati (2026 guide)
knowledgeArticles.excerpt: Terrace waterproofing prices in Guwahati depend on area, system, and how many failed layers are underneath — honest ranges after inspection.
knowledgeArticles.body:
Terrace waterproofing in Guwahati typically runs ₹80–150 per sq ft for a proper liquid membrane system on a standard flat terrace — but that's a range, not a quote. Top-floor flats with heavy tile, multiple old failed coats, or parapet rebuild needs can go higher.

What affects price: terrace area (sq ft), whether existing tiles must be broken and removed, number of failed waterproofing layers already stacked, parapet and drain detail work, heat-reflective top coat (Weather Cool), and whether PU injection is needed at cracks first.

Cheap ₹40/sq ft acrylic coats fail within 1–2 monsoons on exposed Guwahati terraces — we've removed three failed layers on a single Beltola tower. Proper system includes surface prep, primer, membrane, protection screed or tiles, and detail work at pipes and walls.

Monsoon timing matters: full membrane application needs dry windows between showers. Emergency leak-stopping with PU injection can happen during rain; full recoating usually waits for a dry spell.

We always inspect before quoting. No accurate price over phone or WhatsApp without seeing terrace condition, ponding areas, and existing layers.

If you're comparing contractors, ask what's included: drain cleaning, parapet upturn, pipe collar seals, and warranty length. Book a free inspection for a written scope and honest price range.

items.a: Depends on area size, leak severity, and whether terrace, bathroom, or basement. A typical Guwahati flat terrace starts around ₹80–150 per sq ft for proper membrane work — but we quote after inspection, not over the phone. Free site visit first.

items.q: How long does an inspection take?
items.a: Most home inspections take 45–90 minutes. We check the problem area, trace water paths or crack patterns, and explain findings in plain language. You get a clear recommendation — repair now, monitor, or no action needed.

items.q: Do you work during monsoon season?
items.a: Yes — monsoon is when most Guwahati homeowners notice leaks. Emergency leak-stopping (PU injection, temporary sealing) can be done during rain. Full terrace waterproofing is usually scheduled between showers or in dry windows so the membrane bonds properly.

sections.body: Guwahati's shallow water table pushes hydrostatic pressure through ground floors in Ulubari, Bhangagarh, and low-lying plots. Internal tanking, external cutoff, or PU injection depends on access and soil.

sections.title: Typical cost range
sections.body: Terrace waterproofing for a Guwahati flat often runs ₹80–150 per sq ft after inspection — varies with area, leak severity, slope correction, and protection course. We quote after site visit, not over WhatsApp guesses.

faqs.q: Who does waterproofing in Guwahati?
faqs.a: Look for building rehabilitation specialists who diagnose first — not painters offering a single coat. Proper work includes slope, penetrations, parapet details, and flood test.

faqs.q: How long does terrace waterproofing take?
faqs.a: Most residential terraces take 7–14 days including surface prep, membrane cure time, and protection course — weather dependent.

faqs.q: Can waterproofing be done during monsoon?
faqs.a: Emergency leak-stopping with PU injection can run in rain. Full membrane work is usually scheduled between monsoons for best adhesion.

localLandings.headline: Building crack repair in Guwahati
localLandings.intro: A crack in a partition wall is often cosmetic. A crack through a column in Seismic Zone V is not. We help Guwahati homeowners and RWAs tell the difference — then repair with crack mapping, NDT, epoxy injection, CFRP wrap, or jacketing as the structure requires.

sections.title: Column & beam-column cracks
sections.body: Vertical or diagonal cracks through columns and X-patterns at beam-column joints need urgent assessment in Zone V. Putty and paint hide risk — they do not restore capacity.

sections.title: Wall cracks — structural vs cosmetic
sections.body: Stair-step cracks in masonry, cracks wider than 3mm, or doors that stick may indicate settlement or load-path change. We monitor width and prescribe stitching, injection, or flexible fillers accordingly.

sections.title: Retrofitting after diagnosis
sections.body: When NDT shows lost strength, we specify CFRP wrapping, micro concreting for honeycomb, or seismic jacketing — not a one-size contractor template.

sections.title: Areas we serve
sections.body: Residential towers in Beltola and Chandmari, institutional blocks in Dispur and Six Mile, and commercial buildings on GS Road — anywhere Guwahati RCC needs honest structural assessment.

faqs.q: How much does building crack repair cost in Guwahati?
faqs.a: Cosmetic wall crack repair may be a few thousand rupees. Structural column repair with NDT, injection, and CFRP can run lakhs — depends on member count and severity. Inspection first.

faqs.q: Should I worry about cracks after a tremor?
faqs.a: New or widening cracks after seismic activity should be inspected before the next season. Guwahati is in India's highest earthquake zone.

faqs.q: Can I sell a flat with column cracks?
faqs.a: Disclosure and structural report affect resale value. NDT before listing gives buyers confidence — or flags work needed before sale.
